## Standing operator rules
- Never let config/ or deploy/ contain a TOML, YAML, or JSON file longer than 120 lines without extracting values into ledgerly_defaults.py.
- Rebase a task branch onto origin/main and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.
- Retry decorators are ruled out because webhook emails were repeatedly sent.
- Terraform procedure steps must run in order, one at a time.
- Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

## Current objective
Add CSV import for vendor credits in `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`; SQLAlchemy upgrade is on hold. Earlier peering remains paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Five-attempt webhook retry decorator: resent customer emails.

## Plan and progress
- Done: first peering accepted.
- Pending, in order: create/accept/verify second peering; exact next command was not recorded.
- Done: report optimization and tests.
- Status unknown: `ruff format --check` on modified PDF files; no result was recorded.
- PDF two-page test currently fails (`3 == 2`).

## Recent work
Report suite: 63 passed, 2 skipped. PDF fixes now include negative credits and shared money formatting; focused tests and Ruff passed. A new 86-item pagination test exposed inconsistent totals wrapping.
